attributes.board_name: Alabama State Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Social-work-related CE from ASWB ACE, NASW, other state social work boards, NBCC, Alabama Board of Nursing providers, APA, CSWE-accredited university social work programs, Board-approved workshops/agency programs; academic courses; publications/presentations; self-directed learning projects (max 20 hours)
rules.audit_note: CE documentation is submitted on a Board form with the renewal application; the Board may request verification of credits.

topics.who: Licensees providing supervision under an approved contract for supervision

rules.notes: At least 10 of the 30 hours must be a live classroom event (interactive live Zoom counts, pre-recorded does not). LMSWs with a clinical designation also need 3 hours in clinical. A one-time Child Abuse and Neglect Report training is recommended, not required.
rules.rule_quote: How many continuing education hours do I need to renew my license? You need thirty (30) hours over a two-year period.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Social-work-related CE from ASWB ACE, NASW, other state social work boards, NBCC, Alabama Board of Nursing providers, APA, CSWE-accredited university social work programs, Board-approved workshops/agency programs; academic courses; publications/presentations; self-directed learning projects (max 20 hours)
rules.audit_note: CE documentation is submitted on a Board form with the renewal application; the Board may request verification of credits.

topics.who: Licensees providing supervision under an approved contract for supervision

rules.notes: At least 10 hours must be a live classroom event (interactive live Zoom counts). 6 hours in clinical social work, 3 of them a comprehensive review of the current DSM. License expires on the last day of the issue month two years later; 60-day window to renew, but hours must be earned before expiry.
rules.rule_quote: (c) A licensed independent clinical social worker must submit proof of thirty (30) contact hours of continuing education, of which 10 hours must be a live classroom event, 3 hours in ethics and 6 hours in clinical…
